item.title: How many Seattle workers will call out for 'Super Bowl flu' Monday?
item.description: A study by UKG projects that a staggering 26.2 million U.S. employees plan to miss work the Monday after Super Bowl 2026. This marks the second straight year of record-setting absenteeism.

item.title: How many Super Bowls have the Seattle Seahawks won?
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks have won two Super Bowls, capturing the title in the 2013 season with a victory in Super Bowl XLVIII.

item.description: The Seahawks defeated the Patriots in Super Bowl LX to win the second championship in franchise history.

item.title: Kenneth Walker III becomes 1st running back to win Super Bowl MVP in 28 years
item.description: Kenneth Walker III is running into free agency with a Super Bowl MVP. He became the first running back since Terrell Davis 28 years ago to win Super Bowl MVP.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks OC Klint Kubiak will be next Las Vegas Raiders head coach
item.description: Seattle Seahawks offensive coordinator Klint Kubiak is leaving the franchise to become the new head coach of the Las Vegas Raiders.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks MVP Kenneth Walker III to lead Disneyland victory parade
item.description: Super Bowl 2026 MVP Kenneth Walker III and Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will appear in a Disneyland Resort victory parade on Monday, Feb. 9 in Anaheim.

item.title: Fans seen climbing Pergola in Seattle's Pioneer Square after Seahawks' Super Bowl win
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks won Super Bowl 60, prompting celebrations across the city as fans climbed the Pioneer Square pergola.
